calculateur.franceCharges: Automatically applied costs: URSSAF 12.3% of revenue · Stripe fees {stripe} + €0.25 {zone}
calculateur.ukCharges: Automatically applied costs: VAT {vat}% of the selling price (standard rate) · Stripe fees {stripe}% + £{fixe} (domestic card).
calculateur.ukDouane: ⚠️ Customs duty applies above £{seuil} — varies by category, not calculated automatically. Check on gov.uk.
calculateur.ukTauxMarginalNote: Income Tax + Class 4 National Insurance on annual profit — not included in the per-sale margin above, indicative only. Check the thresholds on gov.uk.
calculateur.usStateTaxKnown: Indicative base sales tax: {taux}% — state rate only, excluding county/city surtaxes that may apply depending on the customer's exact location.
calculateur.usStateTaxUnknown: Indicative base sales tax: select a state — state rate only, excluding county/city surtaxes.
calculateur.usNexus: I have economic nexus in this state
calculateur.usCharges: Automatically applied costs: Stripe fees {stripe}% + ${fixe} (domestic card){salesTax}.
calculateur.beCharges: Automatically applied costs: VAT {tva}% of the selling price · Stripe fees {stripe}% + €{fixe} · Self-employed social contributions {cotisations}% on the net margin (not on revenue — see note below the result).
calculateur.chCharges: Automatically applied costs: VAT {tva}% of the selling price · Stripe fees {stripe}% + CHF {fixe} · Self-employed AVS/AI/APG on the net margin (see note below the result).
calculateur.caCharges: Automatically applied costs: GST + QST {tps}% of the selling price · Stripe fees {stripe}% + C${fixe} · QPP + QPIP on the net margin (see note below the result).
calculateur.caPetitFournisseur: Current small supplier threshold at {seuil} CAD — re-confirm on revenuquebec.ca before making any decision.
calculateur.luCharges: Automatically applied costs: VAT {tva}% of the selling price · Stripe fees {stripe}% + €{fixe}. No social contributions deducted here (see note below the result).
calculateur.deCharges: Automatically applied costs: VAT (Mehrwertsteuer) {tva}% of the selling price · Stripe fees {stripe}% + €{fixe}. No contributions deducted here (see note below the result).
calculateur.deCondition1: Kleinunternehmerregelung (§19 UStG), condition 1/2: must stay below €{seuil}.
calculateur.deCondition2: Kleinunternehmerregelung (§19 UStG), condition 2/2: must stay below €{seuil}.
calculateur.deSeuilDepasse: ⚠️ One of the two thresholds is exceeded: the small-business scheme (Kleinunternehmerregelung) is lost — 19% VAT is due on all your invoices. This calculation still assumes you stay below both thresholds.
calculateur.itCoefficiente: Coefficiente di redditività set at {coefficiente}% (non-food retail, the closest to dropshipping) — check your actual ATECO code, this coefficient varies with the declared activity.
calculateur.itCharges: Automatically applied costs: Stripe fees {stripe}% + €{fixe} · VAT 0% (regime forfettario) · Imposta sostitutiva {imposta}% of the selling price.
calculateur.itSeuil: Hard threshold at €{seuil} — not a gradual transition: at the first euro above it, standard 22% VAT becomes mandatory AND the forfettario scheme is permanently lost (this calculation assumes you stay below the threshold).
calculateur.esCharges: Automatically applied costs: IVA {iva}% of the selling price, due from the first euro (no exemption threshold in Spain) · Stripe fees {stripe}% + €{fixe}.
calculateur.margeCibleInatteignable: ⚠️ Unreachable target: the costs + the target margin exceed 100% of the selling price. Lower the target margin or the fixed costs.
calculateur.noteUs1: This calculation does not include customs duties specific to your product category — the de minimis exemption was removed in 2025 and rates vary by customs classification (HTS) and country of origin. Check the real rate on cbp.gov before setting your price. The sales tax rate shown is indicative: your actual obligation to collect it depends on the economic nexus threshold of the state concerned, not only on the sale itself.
calculateur.noteUs2: Plan to set aside a reserve for federal and state income tax on your annual profit — calculated once a year, not per sale. Consult a US accountant for your real rate depending on your structure (LLC, sole proprietor, etc.).
calculateur.noteBe: Contributions are calculated on a provisional basis and adjusted 2-3 years later based on your actual declared annual income (INASTI) — this calculation is an estimate at a point in time.
calculateur.noteCh1: The 10.0% rate applies above CHF {seuil} of net annual income; a decreasing scale applies below, not modelled here — check with your AVS compensation fund if your annual income is lower.
calculateur.noteCh2: Income tax (federal + cantonal + municipal) varies greatly with your canton of residence — calculated once a year, not per sale. Consult a fiduciary for your real rate.
calculateur.noteCa1: This calculation does not include customs duties and import taxes applicable to your product category — check the real threshold and rate on cbsa-asfc.gc.ca before setting your price.
calculateur.noteCa2: QPP + QPIP contributions are capped above $74,600 of net annual income — not modelled here for high incomes.
calculateur.noteCa3: Plan to set aside a reserve for federal and provincial income tax on your annual profit — calculated once a year, not per sale. Consult an accountant for your real rate depending on your structure.
calculateur.noteLu: Self-employed social contributions (CCSS) are calculated on your net annual income, with a rate that varies by status — check on mss.public.lu or with a fiduciary before setting your reserve.
calculateur.noteDe: Gewerbesteuer (trade tax) and Einkommensteuer (income tax) are not included — Gewerbesteuer depends on the municipal rate (Hebesatz) of your registered municipality, with a €24,500 annual profit allowance; Einkommensteuer follows a progressive scale on your total annual income. Check with a Steuerberater (accountant) before setting your reserve.
calculateur.noteIt: INPS contributions not included — Commercianti fund (retail activity): roughly €4,200/year minimum fixed + 24.48% above €17,504 of annual taxable income. Check with a commercialista.
calculateur.noteEs: Autónomo quota (RETA) and IRPF not included — the Spanish system works in monthly net income brackets with an adjustable contribution base, not a fixed percentage. Use the official simulator on seg-social.es to estimate your real quota, and consult a gestor for IRPF (progressive scale 19%-47%).

chain.title: From product idea to delivered order
chain.subtitle: Six steps. One tool. No spreadsheets.
chain.s1Body: Search the AliExpress catalog by niche, price, shipping time and seller. Products with no viable margin are filtered out before you even look at them.
chain.s2Body: Product cost, shipping, payment fees and taxes are deducted automatically. You see your net profit, not the gross margin that looks good on paper.
chain.s3Body: Get a score out of 100 and a list of fixes ranked by impact, based on Nielsen Norman Group, Unbounce and McKinsey research.
chain.s3Fix1: Move the buy button above the fold
chain.s4Body: Single-product page or multi-product store: 4 templates, custom color palettes and pre-written sales copy. Done in a few clicks.
chain.s5Body: New orders from your Shopify store show up in Dropvio and are prepared with your supplier, with every status in one place.
chain.s6Body: As soon as a tracking number exists, it's pushed to Shopify automatically. Your customer is notified, your support inbox stays empty.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Does the Free plan cost anything?
faq.a1: No. The Free account is free, with no time limit, and signing up doesn't ask for a card.
faq.q2: What's the difference between Free, Pro and Agency?
faq.a2: Free: the first 1,000 products in the catalog, 5 generated pages per month, 2 margin simulations, no AI audit. Pro ($29/mo): the full catalog and 30 AI audits per month. Agency ($59/mo): like Pro, with 100 AI audits per month. Pro and Agency are not open yet. The Free plan is available now, without a card.
faq.q3: What happens when I hit my plan's limit?
faq.a3: A clear message tells you which limit you reached (this month's audits, for example) and offers the next plan up if you need it. Nothing blocks without an explanation.
faq.q4: Does the margin calculator really include taxes?
faq.a4: Yes: 10 countries are supported, each with its own rules — URSSAF contributions and VAT in France, state sales tax in the US, VAT in the UK — plus Stripe fees and a manual mode for anything else.
faq.q5: Is my data shared with other users?
faq.a5: No, never. Every account is isolated: nobody else can see your simulations, your sites or your audits.
